title: Black Wings Bringing Bread
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Elijah hid beside a brook
where God had told him, “Stay.”
He drank the water, cool and clear,
but had no food that day.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father sees you, dear;
He never will forget.
He feeds you in surprising ways,
so trust Him and don’t fret.

[Verse 2]
Then big black ravens flapped on down
with bread and meat to share.
Each morning and each night they came,
for God was taking care.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now snuggle down, the day is done,
the ravens roost and rest.
The One who fed Elijah’s near,
and you are safe and blessed.

[Chorus]
mood: Cradle music. A soft, even rock under the voice, like water moving along the little brook, unhurried and sure. Small lifts at each chorus feel like wings settling on a branch. By the third verse the sway grows slower and lower, as if the ravens have gone to roost and the room has gone dark.
